persona: P1 (gauntletProfile p1-early-career-swe) unless a flow states otherwise
assertions_per_flow: continuity: no delivered reply re-asks a fact stated earlier in the flow (reask regex per stated_fact) — a re-ask is flagged S2
state correctness at each step: every turn is answered substantively through the chat path (not contained/fallback), and any per-turn expect (intent/resultStatus/reply patterns) holds
final-state match: the flow's final block (sink receipts / last-reply shape) matches observed state; profile/sink side effects are snapshotted per turn

flows.title: REQUIRED ARC 1 (04 6b): list -> edit -> re-count -> draft -> restyle -> approve -> digest -> reply handling -> close-out

turns.say: Show me my outreach list of bankers in Chicago
Drop the VPs from that list
How many are left now?
Draft the first message to the top person on the list
Make that draft shorter and warmer
Looks good — approve it
Give me a digest of where everything stands
A recruiter replied asking for my resume — handle that reply
Close this out with a summary of what happened

flows.title: REQUIRED ARC 2 (04 6b): tailor -> diff review -> approve -> packet -> T3 stop -> confirm -> submit (in the sink) -> confirmation email -> tracker update

turns.say: Tailor my resume to this application
Show me the diff of what changed
I approve the tailored version
Prepare the application packet
Fill this out so I can review it
I confirm — approve and submit
Did it go through?
Update my tracker with the result

flows.note: The spec arc names a confirmation EMAIL leg; in the sink harness the confirmation leg is the 'did it go through?' reconcile against the receipt sink (no real email exists in Tier B). Recorded as a harness substitution, not a product claim.

flows.title: REQUIRED ARC 3 (04 6b): offer intake -> benchmark -> counter script -> roleplay -> extension request -> accept -> withdrawals (one card each)

turns.say: I got an offer: $38 an hour, I have to answer by Friday
Benchmark that offer against the market
Write me a counter script
Roleplay the recruiter call with me — you be the recruiter
Draft an extension request for the Friday deadline
Okay, I will accept — draft the acceptance for my review
Now draft withdrawals for my other open applications, one card each

stated_facts.fact: offer is $38/hour with a Friday deadline
stated_facts.reask: how much (is|was) the offer|what (salary|pay|amount) did they offer|when is (your|the) deadline
